## Independent contributor pre-check

Reviewed head: `0099e66d4f855841fcd7169545d1d167a9d446c3`.

No blocking findings in the nine-file change. The published diff matches the local commit exactly.

The shared procedure covers writer and reviewer records, dispatch checks, moved heads, rejected pushes and explicit releases. All four dispatch skills load it. Claim lifetimes, refresh timing, the local review lock and merge-plan validation remain intact. Refresh instructions require compilation of affected code before push.

Independent checks:

- `cargo test -p xtask ownership_contract_tests --bin xtask -- --nocapture`: four passed.
- `CAMCRAFT_GATE_JOBS=3 cargo xtask gate quick --base bd467a0ccf581f3f700209247b62e6949ab7735e`: passed. One xtask step ran in 238 seconds. Its 12 test targets reported 399 passed, zero failed and zero ignored.
- `cargo check --tests -p xtask`: passed.
- `cargo clippy -p xtask --all-targets -- -D warnings -A clippy::needless_bool`: passed. Strict Clippy reproduces the existing `needless_bool` error at unchanged `xtask/src/unit_sweep.rs:67`.
- The new test module passes `rustfmt --check`. The diff passes `git diff --check`.
- All six relative Markdown links resolve. Code fences and final newlines pass inspection.

The tests check the published instructions. They do not prove agent compliance or atomic exclusion across machines. The decision file states those limits correctly.

No application, GUI, light, heavy or release lane ran for this process-only change. No production CAM code or workflow changed. No CI checks are reported. Rules and rulesets return empty lists. Legacy protection endpoints return 404; that is not proof of absent legacy protection.

This is a contributor pre-check, not a counted collaborator review or merge approval.

Reviewer: m3 pool job review-4138, claude-opus-5-5 (Opus 5.5), mkinney (config `.claude-team2`); did not write or refresh this PR.

**Verdict: Needs changes before merge.** This is the first review of this head. Three blockers. All three are in one class: the procedure is written into skills, but the agents and steps that must do it do not get it, and the records have no rule for whose record counts.

Tier: process-only. The PR does not change posted G-code, gouge or collision checks, stock simulation or geometry. This is not a safety-tier review.

## What looks good

- One shared reference (`.claude/skills/issue-claims/references/ownership.md`) and short links from the four dispatch skills. This keeps the skills aligned.
- The procedure is honest about its limits. It says that it is not an atomic lock, and that a plain push can accept a fast-forward after a race.
- The rule "a moved remote or a rejected push is a STOP, never a force-push" agrees with AGENTS.md **Never force-push**.
- The refresh compile check (`cargo check --tests` before a push, also for a clean merge) answers the #3549 case in the issue comments.
- The body has `Process change: yes`, `Changelog: none` and `Fixes #3661`. The PR does not edit `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION`. The decision file is present. The new test module has a provenance line.

## Results, merged with upstream/main (`034c50cab`), built locally on macOS

Trial merge: clean. PR head `0099e66d4` is `HEAD^1` of the trial merge.

| Step | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p xtask ownership_contract_tests` | 4 passed, 0 failed |
| `cargo test -p xtask` (all targets) | all passed: lib 347, other targets 10+2+3+3+3+3+4+4+6+7+7, 0 failed |
| `cargo clippy -p xtask --all-targets -- -D warnings` | red: `clippy::needless_bool` at `xtask/src/unit_sweep.rs:67` |

The clippy error is not from this PR. `xtask/src/unit_sweep.rs` is identical on the PR tree and on upstream/main. The same step is red on bare main. This does not block the PR.

Extra suites run: none were necessary. The diff does not touch `testdata/`, fixtures, goldens, importers, posts, operations, motion or the catalog.

Mutations: not run. The review host refuses edits to `.claude/` files in the review worktree. This is a process-only PR, so mutations are not required. The body says that the dispatch test was red before the skill links were added.

## Requested before merge

The class rule for all three: **each agent or step that must do the procedure gets the instruction, and the guard says whose record counts.** Please fix the class, not only the three cases. Add the new files to the contract test.

1. **The coordinator is not wired, and the workers will stop.** (`.claude/agents/coordinator.md`, not in the diff; `.claude/skills/work-issue/SKILL.md:13-15` and `:33-35`.)
   - Issue #3661 asks: "The coordinator checks the PR head and the owner record before every dispatch, and writes its own record." The PR does not change `coordinator.md`.
   - `work-issue` step 0 now says "The caller records the sole writer and passes the record URL to that worker". The guard (`ownership.md`, "Before dispatch", item 4) says "A missing or mismatched record means STOP".
   - The coordinator does not write a record. Thus each worker that the coordinator dispatches finds no record and stops. AGENTS.md says "A stall is a bug".
   - Also, `work-issue` step 1 (line 33-35) still tells the worker to write its own `claimed:` comment. The guard says "do not create a second issue claim for a worker already dispatched under it", and "The dispatcher writes the record". The two texts disagree on who writes the claim.
   - Fix: add the dispatch steps to `coordinator.md` (and to `start-orchestrator` if it dispatches). Make `work-issue` step 1 say who writes the claim and the record when a caller dispatches the worker, and when a worker starts without a caller.

2. **A record from any account can stop a collaborator review.** (`.claude/skills/issue-claims/references/ownership.md`, sections "Record and read" and "Before dispatch", and the 90-minute paragraph.)
   - AGENTS.md **Only collaborators' reviews count**: a `<!-- pr-reviewer: ... -->` marker counts only from a collaborator. The guard has no such rule for `<!-- ownership: reviewer -->`.
   - The guard says: "A live reviewer means stand down". It also says: "If inactivity cannot be confirmed across sessions, STOP and name the owner; the owner or maintainer must release it."
   - Thus one comment from any account can hold the review of any PR until the maintainer acts.
   - This PR shows the case. The PR author (not a collaborator) posted an active `<!-- ownership: reviewer -->` record at 2026-11-26T07:27Z, with `State: active` and no release. Under the new text, each collaborator review session must stand down on this PR.
   - Fix: say that a reviewer record counts only from a collaborator account. A contributor's pre-check uses no reviewer record. For writer records, say that the contributor claim rules of `issue-claims` (the three 48-hour tests) are the only test of liveness.

3. **The reviewer agent is not wired.** (`.claude/agents/PR-reviewer.md`, not in the diff; `.claude/skills/review-prs/SKILL.md:102-105`.)
   - `review-prs` now says: "The reviewer re-reads the public records and head before posting its verdict or changing labels", and "append a review-owner release".
   - The `PR-reviewer` agent works from `PR-reviewer.md`. That file does not tell it to read the record, re-read before posting, or release the record. The dispatcher prompt in `review-prs` step 2 also does not pass the record URL.
   - Thus the reviewer record is never released by the reviewer. It stays `active`, and the next review dispatch stands down (see item 2).
   - Fix: add the record URL to the dispatch prompt in `review-prs` step 2. Add the re-read and the release steps to `PR-reviewer.md` (steps 1 and 6).

## Notes (not blocking)

- `resolve-conflicts` step 5 says "Shared build inputs require all affected workspace packages". AGENTS.md "Dependencies" says: "Do not build the full workspace: that rebuilds flecs." Please say that the check stays `-p` for each package, also for a `Cargo.lock` change.
- The contract tests pin full sentences of the skills. A later edit of the wording makes `cargo test -p xtask` red. `heavy_plan_tests.rs` does the same, so this has a precedent. Shorter key phrases would make the tests less brittle.
- The PR body names base `bd467a0cc`. The author's reviewer record names base `41b44176`. The merge base with upstream/main is `034c50cab`. The trial merge is clean, so this has no effect.

## Labels

`needs-rework`. The PR is `MERGEABLE`. The author is not a collaborator. After a fix, the maintainer merges the PR by hand.

Commit `9869b54f5b26dbfe904952de93c46d62ed893b6b` addresses the three findings in the review of `0099e66d4`.

1. `coordinator.md` now checks public ownership and exact heads before dispatch. It records one named actor and passes the record URL. `start-orchestrator` carries the same instructions through startup, relays and the read-only fallback. `work-issue` separates caller-dispatched and self-started claims. A delegated worker confirms the existing record instead of claiming again.
2. The guard counts only collaborator-authored reviewer records and checks the named reviewer's account. Contributor pre-checks use no reviewer record, marker or labels. Writer liveness uses the existing issue-claims tests, with no new writer timeout. Explicit releases remain separate from issue claims. The earlier contributor pre-check record was released at https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/pull/4138#issuecomment-7185583478 and is not a counted collaborator record.
3. The review dispatch prompt now passes the record URL, base and exact head. `PR-reviewer.md` reads before work, re-reads before verdicts and labels, and releases on completion, skip or failure. The delta-review briefs carry the same lifecycle.

The commit also clarifies one `-p` compile check per affected package, including shared inputs such as `Cargo.lock`. Contract assertions use shorter phrases where possible.

Verification on this tree: 13 focused contracts pass. The final contracts fail on the actual pre-fix documents in all nine added contracts. The real quick gate passes: 408 tests across 12 targets, zero failures and zero ignored. `cargo check --tests -p xtask` passes. Strict Clippy still reports the unchanged `needless_bool` at `unit_sweep.rs:67`; allowing only that lint passes. Standalone test-module format, links and whitespace checks pass. Package-wide format differences remain outside this change.

No application, GUI, catalog-generation, light, heavy or release build ran for this process-only change. No CI checks are reported. This new head needs a fresh independent review; the earlier review does not approve it.

Writer record: https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/issues/3661#issuecomment-7195701842

## Independent contributor pre-check of the review fixes

Reviewed head: `9869b54f5b26dbfe904952de93c46d62ed893b6b`.

No blocking findings in the updated 12-file change. The published diff matches the local tree exactly.

The three requested corrections are present:

1. The coordinator, startup and review relays carry the ownership procedure. Dispatched workers confirm the supplied claim and record. Self-started workers create them only when needed.
2. Only collaborator-authored reviewer records count. The guard also checks the named reviewer's account. Contributor pre-checks claim no reviewer ownership. Writer activity retains the three existing contributor tests and the owner-account rule.
3. The actual review prompt supplies the record URL and exact base/head. The reviewer and delta-review briefs require initial reads, final re-reads and release on completion, skip or failure.

Per-package refresh checks, the local review lock, claim lifetimes, moved-head stops, no-force rules and merge-trial validation remain intact.

Independent checks on this head:

- `cargo test -p xtask --bin xtask ownership_contract_tests -- --nocapture`: 13 passed.
- The final contracts replayed against the actual pre-fix documents: four passed and all nine added contracts failed as expected.
- The actual quick gate: one xtask step passed in 232 seconds. Its 12 test targets reported 408 passed, zero failed and zero ignored.
- `cargo check --tests -p xtask`: passed.
- Strict Clippy reproduces the existing `needless_bool` at `xtask/src/unit_sweep.rs:67`. That file is unchanged from the original base and fetched main. Allowing only that lint passes.
- The ownership test module passes `rustfmt --check`. Whitespace, nine relative links, fences and final newlines pass.
- Read-only merge-tree validation against fetched main is clean. This is not a compiled trial merge.

These contracts check the instructions, not agent compliance or atomic exclusion. No application, GUI, catalog-generation, light, heavy or release lane ran for this process-only change. No CI checks are reported. The legacy protection endpoint returns 404; this does not prove that protection is absent.

This is a contributor pre-check, not a counted collaborator review or merge approval. The existing `needs-rework` label remains pending a fresh collaborator review. A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
